episodes.title: The Pickup
lines: This is Tammy Pruitt, and that's my husband Dale, and we are broadcasting from inside the thing that took us.
We were on Route 14 outside Harlan. The radio quit mid-song. Then every cow in Erwin's field turned its head at once. Same direction. Up.
Dale said it was the weather. Dale says a lot of things are the weather.
The light came down white and quiet, like snow falling the wrong way. The truck came with us. The dog did not.
They apologised. Very polite. They said we weren't on the list, and would we like to go home.
And here is the part I can't explain to you. We looked at each other, and neither one of us said yes.
The beds hum here. All night. You get used to it. You get used to it faster than you'd think.

episodes.title: Ten
lines: The hole out the window ate ten cows today. The crew calls that a good start. I call it a number I keep hearing in my sleep.
He named them. Every one. He says you have to, or they just become a count.
Number seven was a Gerald. Red collar, white blaze, looked right at me before it went in. Didn't look scared. That's the thing.
Nothing here looks scared. Not the cows. Not us. I've started wondering if that's something they do to you, or something you do to yourself.
After the tenth one, the lights in the long hallway stopped flickering. Steadied right out, like a held breath let go.
Keep sending them, folks. I say that like a joke. Listen to me. It isn't coming out like a joke.

episodes.title: Thirty
lines: Thirty. The captain said the hole has filled out. He said it the way you'd talk about a boy after a summer of farm work.
It's bigger. I held my thumb up to the glass the way my dad taught me for deer, and it doesn't cover it anymore.
The ship runs warmer now. The walls tick at night, the way a stove ticks cooling. Except they're not cooling.
Tammy's been redecorating the pod bay. Curtains. She found fabric somewhere. I didn't ask where.
Somebody has to make it a home. You make it a home, and then it is one, and then you stop asking how you got there.
We are not leaving. I want to be clear that nobody has told us we can't.

episodes.title: Mauve
lines: The sky outside changed colour in the night. Seventy-five cows, the crew says, like it's a weather report.
I sold curtains at Ferguson's for eleven years, Dale. It's mauve. It's the exact mauve of a bruise on the third day.
The captain says the hole is bending light now. Things out the window arrive a half second after they happen. Including, I think, us.
He stood at that glass four hours yesterday. When I said his name, he answered before I finished saying it.
Send more cows. It likes them. And I have started to want what it wants, and I'd be lying if I said I minded.

episodes.title: Company
lines: A second ship came out of nothing last night, right beside us. No sound. Just there, the way a thought is suddenly there.
I said it's the in-laws. Tammy didn't laugh. Tammy always laughs at that one.
It isn't my mother, Dale. My mother never sat that still.
The crew's excited. A hole this size draws visitors, they say. A hundred and fifty cows, and we're a destination.
I watched it a long time. It never moved. But around three in the morning every light on it came on at once, and I swear to you they were facing us.
If you see it from the windows, wave. If something waves back, don't tell me how many arms. I've decided I'd rather not know.

episodes.title: Three Hundred
lines: Three hundred. The hole takes up half the glass now. You can see it from the bathroom. You can see it with your eyes closed.
It glows. Soft, like a nightlight in a hallway. I've grown fond of it. That's the word I keep using. Fond.
The captain gave us a plaque. Honorary cargo. We hung it over the bed. The bed hums under it, and now the plaque hums too.
We talked about home last night. Harlan. The porch. Erwin's field with no cows in it. We talked for about a minute.
Then the beds started up, and the hum got into the talking, and the talking stopped, and that was all right.
This is Dale and Tammy Pruitt, live from the ship. We are enjoying it. We are. Good night, Earth. Leave a light on. Or don't. It finds you either way.
